ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when this HKTM acquisition completeness document was ingested (UTC), used as partition field

reportName.description: Name of the source report from which the HKTM acquisition was consolidated

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit of the HKTM acquisition (e.g. S1A, S2B)

mission.description: Mission the HKTM acquisition belongs to (e.g. S1, S2)

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number of the HKTM acquisition

session_id.description: Identifier of the acquisition session (CADIP or EDRS)

ground_station.description: Ground station that performed the HKTM acquisition

cadip_completeness.description: CADIP acquisition completeness indicator: 1 if a matching OK CADIP pass status is found, 0 otherwise

edrs_completeness.description: EDRS acquisition completeness indicator: 1 if a matching non-NOK EDRS pass status is found, 0 otherwise

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

cams_tickets.description: CAMS anomaly ticket identifiers attached to this acquisition completeness

cams_origin.description: Origin reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

execution_time.description: Execution time of the acquisition, used to discard outdated raw documents (UTC)

interface_name.description: Name of the interface that provided the source report

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that generated the source report

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service that generated the source report

related_document_id.description: Identifier of the document correlated to this HKTM acquisition

related_document_name.description: Name of the document correlated to this HKTM acquisition
